prose: Bloomberg traces how a Blackstone-led $2.3 billion private credit loan to CoreWeave in 2023 - backed by GPU chips as collateral - became the blueprint for a chip-backed debt market that is now on track to reach $1 trillion, upending parts of the credit business. The full account is behind Bloomberg's bot protection.
highlights: A 2023 Blackstone-led $2.3B private credit loan to CoreWeave pioneered chip-backed debt.
GPU-collateralized lending is now on track to become a $1 trillion market (Bloomberg).
The structure is reshaping parts of private credit; full reporting unavailable here.
